resources.string: Choose 1 to 60 seconds for each opening attempt. Applies from the next channel you open.
Startup service failed (%1$s). Disable and enable the service in Accessibility, then retry.

If Android blocks activation, open the app information and look for Allow restricted settings, if available. Then return to Accessibility. If it switches off without a message, report that behaviour; activation is not confirmed until the service shows On here.
